propositions: A class with an unreachable primary model must fall back to a configured fallback entry without failing the gate outright.

FallbackModel must be constructed with a fallback_on predicate derived from failure._RETRYABLE plus CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL to distinguish errors where provider switching helps from errors that should fail loudly.
Fallback entries must support inline endpoint configuration so a local proxy can back a hosted primary, with each entry built through the full provider path including its own endpoint.

Capabilities must be computed as the conservative intersection over all candidates (primary and fallbacks) before the FallbackModel wrapper is constructed, and capabilities_for must never be called on a FallbackModel instance itself.
The ProviderSession must enter and exit all sub-model providers through the FallbackModel's async context manager, with rebar-created transports registered and closed exactly once on _closeables.

The runner must record both the ordered candidate list and the ran_model from ModelResponse.model_name in provenance, not FallbackModel.model_name, so a verdict produced by a fallback attests the correct model.
